package.name: custom_covariance
package.description: Workspace-owned corrections to sensor uncertainty that the vendor drivers do not provide. Currently one node: it republishes the ZED wrapper's odometry with a real twist covariance, which the wrapper leaves as all zeros and has no parameter to set. Lives beside the ZED submodule so everything camera-related stays in one place, but is OUR code -- nothing here is touched by `git submodule update`.
